SDC1 staged delivery: SKA1-MID AA0.5 L-band (1 h, SEFD noise)
SKA1-MID AA0.5 (4 SKA dishes, max baseline 1.4 km; the first deployment stage, with extremely limited uv-coverage) observing the SDC1 560-1400 MHz crossed catalogue (sources >= 10 uJy, real spectral indices) for 1 h in Band 2 (1.31 GHz, 720 MHz, 64 channels). Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (SKA 304 Jy, MeerKAT 461 Jy, eta_c 0.95), ideal with no RFI flagging.
